title: Design catalog spec
description: Code-led design-catalog spec: declares which @Preview composables (by function name) make up a published sticker sheet, their grouping, sections, captions, and per-component variants. Consumed by scripts/design-artifacts/generate-design-catalog.mjs over a `compose-preview bundle pack` render. Each `preview` MUST equal an exact @Preview function name in the rendered module; validate before rendering with `node scripts/design-artifacts/validate-catalog-spec.mjs`.

system.description: Stable slug identifying the system; the delivery branch is design-artifacts/<system> and the preview server serves it at /<system>/.

title.description: Human-readable catalog name shown in the preview server.

library.description: Informational: the design-system libraries this catalog covers.

module.description: Gradle module path whose @Preview functions this spec references (e.g. ":app", "samples:design-catalog-m3"). Used by validate-catalog-spec.mjs to locate the Kotlin sources; the render is driven separately by the workflow.

modes.description: Informational: the theme modes the sticker sheet covers (e.g. ["light", "dark"]).

breakpoints.description: Informational: the width breakpoints the sticker sheet documents.

referenceKits.description: Informational: published design-kit URLs a component seeds from for the one-off import (the render stays authoritative).

compareWith.description: Optional slug of a sibling system to pair against on the cross-system compare page; components carry `parallel` handles into it.

display.description: Optional presentation hints carried onto catalog.json so the preview server reads them instead of inferring — the stage surface and the hero preview to feature on the index.

surface.description: The stage background this system's stickers are drawn for. `dark` for a dark-first platform (Wear OS), so a light-on-transparent sticker isn't washed out on a white stage. Absent ⇒ light.

hero.description: The representative preview to feature as the system's hero — a componentId (e.g. "Template/TimeText") or a flattened preview id. Absent ⇒ the server picks one (prefer a screen, else a canonical component).

groups.description: The component inventory, grouped. Group order is the display order.

name.description: Sub-heading for this group of components.

section.description: Optional top-level TAB the preview server buckets this group under (Themes / Components / Screens / Animations / …). Sits one level above `name`. Absent ⇒ a flat, untabbed catalog.

componentId.description: Stable id for the component/state, e.g. "Button/Filled". Unique across the whole spec.

preview.description: EXACT @Preview function name that renders this component. Must match a discovered @Preview (or multipreview) function in `module`.

caption.description: One-line description shown under the sticker.

reference.description: Optional seed-kit handle (Figma node etc.) for the one-off import.

parallel.description: Optional componentId of the counterpart in the `compareWith` sibling system, paired side-by-side on the cross-system compare page.

component.description: Optional Code Connect override: the production composable name the sticker maps to (takes priority over the inferred target when building code-connect.json).

import.description: Optional Code Connect override: the import line for `component`.

source.description: Optional Code Connect override: the source location (path or URL) for `component`.

variants.description: Extra state/content renders folded onto this sticker; each is its own @Preview.

variant.description: A secondary render of the parent component, tagged by `state` (pressed/focused/disabled/…), named `props` content axes, or a `theme` (light/dark, for a screen whose two themes are separate @Preview functions). Give at least one so it's distinguishable from the default.

preview.description: EXACT @Preview function name for this variant render.

state.description: The interaction/state this variant shows (pressed, keyboard-focus, disabled, off, …).

props.description: Named content axes distinguishing this variant (e.g. { "content": "icon+label" } or { "locale": "de" }).

theme.description: Pairs a separate-function theme render onto this component so it folds into one …__light/…__dark swap card — use when a screen's light and dark renders are two @Preview functions (e.g. FooScreen + FooScreenDark) rather than one multipreview. The dark render must set uiMode = UI_MODE_NIGHT_YES so its pixels are actually dark; this tag makes the pairing authoritative.
